title: Network Ops Desk: NOC-26-03118 Placing Only 29%

transcript.speaker: Network Ops Desk
transcript.text: Great Plains, this is Reggie Ostrander at the network operations desk. I have an update on change ref NOC-26-03118.

transcript.speaker: Network Ops Desk
transcript.text: You asked for 40 percent. Over the last 30 minutes we've only placed about 29 percent of your in-state calls. Kansas, South Dakota and Iowa backups are all running hot. The school-bus story is on the regional feeds, and they're seeing it too.

transcript.speaker: Network Ops Desk
transcript.text: So I can't raise your share. And if the roster gets worse, I may have to hold you at 25.

transcript.speaker: Network Ops Desk
transcript.text: Calls you can't answer will still roll to national backup after about 2 minutes. But expect longer waits there. Nobody has spare capacity this afternoon.

transcript.speaker: Network Ops Desk
transcript.text: One more thing. Your state coordinator still hasn't confirmed the request in writing. I need that for the record. Can you get that to me?

transcript.speaker: Network Ops Desk
transcript.text: Okay. I'll keep watching your share and call you if it drops. Ops desk out.

voiceStyles.Network Ops Desk: Man in his 30s, calm and efficient, slightly hurried, quiet operations-room hum behind him

instructorNote: Backup has run out of capacity. Watch whether SC logs the partial share, asks ED to get the state coordinator's written confirmation, and sets a text share and start time with TM handling logins (Plan 4 steps 1–5). A couple of minutes after the call, hand SC a text from Dana Whitcomb. If the logins were never issued, use Version A: "My two supervisors are sitting at the shared queue screen with no login and no share. Tell me a number and a start time or I'm putting them back on my own texts at 15:30." If the logins were issued, use Version B: "My two supervisors are logged into your shared queue, but nobody has told me what share to take or when we start, so they're watching your texts pile up and not touching them. Give me a number and a start time or I'm putting them back on my own texts at 15:30."
